id: title:adamleithp:keep space list filters and tab space across switches

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop application session and workspace preservation while loading channel lists.
review.reason: The chunk implements a localized UI behavior: replacing a scoped space ID with a stamped one and adding a loading state to preserve the user's workspace while the channel list loads. This prevents the workspace from clearing and the tab from opening incorrectly. This is a bounded, substantive correctness improvement for the desktop client.
